title: Indian Men's Badminton Team Clinches Asian Games Bronze
indian_angle: India's men's team secured a historic bronze medal at the Asian Games after a strong campaign.
summary: The Indian men's badminton team earned a bronze medal at the Asian Games 2026 after a hard-fought 1-3 loss to China in the semifinals.

title: Sindhu-led Indian Women's Team Exits Asian Games Quarterfinals
indian_angle: The Indian women's badminton team, featuring star PV Sindhu, concluded their Asian Games campaign after a quarterfinal defeat.
summary: The Indian women's badminton team was knocked out of the Asian Games after a 1-3 loss to Japan in the quarterfinals, despite a win from Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand.

title: India Men's Team Assured of Asian Games Medal After Beating Japan
indian_angle: The Indian men's badminton team guaranteed themselves a medal at the Asian Games by defeating Japan in a crucial match.
summary: The Indian men's badminton team secured at least a bronze medal at the Asian Games 2026 by overcoming Japan in the team event, advancing to the semifinals.

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: India Adds Bronze in Men's Badminton
indian_angle: India's overall medal count at the Asian Games increased with the men's badminton team securing a bronze.
summary: The latest Asian Games medal tally shows India adding a bronze medal from the men's badminton team event, alongside a silver from Mirabai Chanu.
